exposure: Gestational age at PA assessment (17-22 weeks, 27-30 weeks)
Women with high volume of PA (>97.5 percentile) excluded in a sensitivity analysis
Maternal physical activity (total and moderate-to-vigorous) at 17-22 weeks and 27-30 weeks gestation
cohort: 1205 pregnant women from North Carolina, without prior cesarean delivery.
finding: No significant association was found between maternal physical activity and cesarean delivery risk after adjusting for confounding factors.
